newsitem.title: USA: Valujet says it has $179 mln cash in bank.
newsitem.headline: Valujet says it has $179 mln cash in bank.

text.p: ValuJet Inc, which flew for only one day during the recent third quarter, said Tuesday it has $179 million cash in the bank.
Despite its troubles, the airline "continues to be among the strongest in the entire industry," ValuJet Chairman and Chief Executive Robert Priddy said in a statement.
ValuJet Airlines, a subsidiary of ValuJet Inc, resumed operations on September 30, the last day of its third quarter.

Its flights had been suspended in June after a U.S. Federal Aviation Administration review found serious deficiencies in its operations following the May 11 crash of flight 592 in the Florida Everglades in which all 110 people on board were killed.
For the quarter, the company reported a net loss of $21.95 million, or $0.40 per share, which included a $23 million charge for shutdown and other non-recurring expenses.
In the prior year's third quarter, the company reported net income of $22.66 million, or $0.38 per share.
